---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new stage, tool integration, or report improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like binscope to do**
A clear description of the capability.

**Which tool / stage**
If it wraps a new tool, name it and link its project. Note the platforms it
supports and whether it executes the target.

**Why**
What question about a binary would this help answer?

**Scope check**
Confirm this is for authorized analysis (defense, CTF, research,
interoperability, debugging) and not DRM-bypass, cheats, or evasion — those are
out of scope.
